cohort: All patients attending the Obstetrics/Gynae department for delivery at Liaquat Memorial Hospital (LMH) Kohat from January 2019 to December 2019.
finding: The rate of cesarean section at LMH hospital Kohat was slightly higher (19.89%) than the WHO recommended average cesarean rate of 15%, with the highest proportion of cesarean sections observed in Robson's classification R5 (multiparous women with at least one previous CS).
